limits: Enabled manager membership is distinct from all registered definitions and from runtime completion status.
Raw Value, RequiredCount, Standing and XPReward are not normalized native getter results. Absent defaults stay null.
Scope/name overrides and explicit language tags are preserved; no basename-derived localized labels are invented.
Scripts and their behavior bodies are not executed. Season-family membership includes calendar challenges, not only Nightwave.
Parents refer to explicit completion/event links, not resource inheritance; array order and duplicates are retained.
